A LITTLE ABOUT ME

Law, leadership
and the bigger picture.

BE CURIOUS. ASK BETTER QUESTIONS.

I graduated from Nepal Law Campus with a B.A.LL.B. degree and a 3.67 CGPA. My interests extend beyond the classroom—to legal research, public dialogue, human rights and building spaces where young people can participate in meaningful change.

Alongside my legal education, I have taken on leadership roles in student and youth organisations, contributed to advocacy initiatives and written on questions of Nepalese law. These experiences shape how I approach legal questions: with careful research, clear communication and an awareness of the people affected.
